title: Jack Dorsey’s Bitchat disappears from app stores in India after government order
summary: Jack Dorsey's Bitchat messaging app has been restricted and largely removed from Indian app stores following a government order. The move reflects escalating tensions between tech platforms and Indian regulatory authorities over content moderation and data handling.
content: Bitchat has become largely unavailable in India as a result of the restrictions.

zh.title: 杰克·多西的Bitchat在政府令后从印度应用商店消失
zh.summary: 杰克·多西的Bitchat消息应用在政府命令后被限制并基本上从印度应用商店移除。此举反映了科技平台与印度监管部门在内容审核和数据处理方面的日益紧张的关系。

title: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava thinks AI emails are killing conversations
summary: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava believes AI-generated emails are eroding meaningful human conversation and workplace communication. Srivastava, formerly of Flickr, Yahoo, GitHub, and Adobe, oversees the music sampling platform trusted by major artists.
content:
Kakul Srivastava is the CEO of Splice, the sample platform countless producers rely on for one-shots and melodic loops. Samples pulled from the service have found their way into massive hits like Lisa's "Money" and "Espresso" by Sabrina Carpenter. (The original samples are here and here, for the curious.)
Before that, Kakul held executive roles at Flickr, Yahoo, GitHub, and Adobe. Throughout her career, Kakul has found herself at the intersection of Silicon Valley and creatives. zh.summary: Splice首席执行官卡库尔·斯里瓦斯塔瓦认为，人工智能生成的电子邮件正在侵蚀有意义的人类交流和工作场所沟通。曾在Flickr、Yahoo、GitHub和Adobe工作过的斯里瓦斯塔瓦，现监督这个受到主要艺术家信任的音乐采样平台。

title: Vessev built an electric ferry that almost flies
summary: Vessev has developed an electric hydrofoil ferry designed to transform urban water transportation and sustainability. The vessel combines electric propulsion with hydrofoil technology to challenge conventional approaches to maritime travel.
content: Vessev hopes its electric hydrofoil ferry will change the way people and cities think about boats.

zh.title: Vessev制造了一艘几乎能飞行的电动渡轮
zh.summary: Vessev开发了一种电动水翼渡轮，旨在改变城市水上运输和可持续性。该船只结合了电力推进和水翼技术，以挑战传统海上旅行方法。

title: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
summary: David Robinson, who authored OpenAI's safety reports for major model releases, has resigned and published a critical editorial in The Atlantic alleging systemic safety culture failures. Robinson argues that industry problems require fundamental cultural reform beyond policy adjustments.
content:
David Robinson used to write the safety reports that accompanied every major model release at OpenAI. This week, he resigned from his position and is now speaking out in an editorial in The Atlantic.
It's understandable if you're feeling a bit cynical about everyone suddenly coming out of the woodwork to warn about how dangerous the thing they helped build is. They did, after all, make this mess. But that doesn't mean we should discount their warnings. 
Robinson says that the culture in industry is fundamentally broken. That this is a deeper issue than simply slapping a few new rules or regulations on how we handle training models. Silicon …

title: Spotify billionaire’s body scan startup has come to America
summary: Neko Health, a health tech startup backed by Spotify's billionaire investors, has launched in America offering advanced body scanning technology. The company focuses on preventative health screening and early disease detection.
content: Farooq Abbasi, an investor in Neko Health, talked to Equity about the hot health tech company and what's next for it.

title: 3D movies are finally worth watching
summary: More than 15 years after Avatar's theatrical release, 3D video glasses technology has matured enough to deliver a compelling viewing experience for 3D content. Modern AR/VR glasses now provide full resolution and brightness without the compromises of traditional theater glasses.
content:
My colleague Cameron Faulkner models a pair of Xreal glasses. | Photo: Cameron Faulkner / The Verge	

Why am I suddenly buying up every 3D Blu-ray I can find after 3D became one of the biggest tech flops of all time? 
The technology's finally ready for 3D movies to shine, more than 15 years since James Cameron's Avatar wowed me on the big screen and went on to become the highest-grossing film worldwide. Video glasses are giving me the experience I've always desired.
I've always loved 3D movies, but viewing them was awkward. Walking into a movie theater with a pair of polarized glasses, I would only get half the resolution and roughly half the brightness, since those glasses had to split one reflected image between my two eyes. Almost every …

content: The devices continue to show noticeable benefits for users in various real-world tasks.

title: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused
summary: Meta is releasing Muse code as open source to enable integration into consumer devices like TVs and toasters. The move aims to expand Muse's presence beyond current platforms into household appliances.
content: Meta wants Muse in your TV and your toaster, so it's giving the code away for free.

zh.title: Meta 希望你的下一个小工具采用 Muse
zh.summary: Meta 正在将 Muse 代码作为开源发布，以实现与电视和烤面包机等消费设备的集成。此举旨在将 Muse 的存在扩展到当前平台之外，进入家用电器领域。

title: Sanders introduces bill to ban the federal government from using Flock
summary: Senator Sanders has introduced legislation that would prohibit federal government use of Flock, the controversial automatic license plate reader system. The bill would extend restrictions to all automated license plate reader technology used by federal agencies.
content: The proposed legislation would extend to all automotica license plate readers.

zh.title: Sanders 议员提出法案禁止联邦政府使用 Flock
zh.summary: Sanders 议员提出了将禁止联邦政府使用争议性的自动车牌读取系统 Flock 的立法。该法案将把限制扩展到联邦机构使用的所有自动车牌读取技术。
